# transmit_oncall_responder (Data Source)

Looks up a responder by email, for configurations whose responders are managed outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "transmit_oncall_responder" "dana" {
  configuration_id = data.transmit_oncall_configuration.imported.id
  email            = "dana@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration_id` (String)
- `email` (String)

### Read-Only

- `contact_verified` (Boolean)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
